name: rad-plan
description: Evidence-based implementation planning for Codex with outcome coverage, safe recovery, focused linting, risk review, rescue, replan, and plan-audit workflows. It plans work and documentation; it does not implement application code.

interface.shortDescription: Build, rescue, update, and audit executable project plans.
interface.longDescription: RAD Plan checks the real repository, asks focused questions, and creates one executable project plan with outcome coverage and safe recovery steps. It can rescue unclear projects, update plans from Git evidence, and audit existing plans. Quick mode fits small changes. Full mode adds deeper discovery and bounded risk review. It does not implement application code.
defaultPrompt: Create a risk-first implementation plan for this project.
Rescue this unclear project and rebuild its plan from evidence.
Review docs/plan.md for mechanical and architectural risks.
